text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my lunch break one day, I find Oguri
Cap
clutching a lunch box and letting
out a subtle
sigh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given her famously enormous appetite,
I'm
surprised she's not at the cafeteria
scarfing down
everything in sight.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Urk...
It's no use. I'm still hungry...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I can't go to the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was eating my usual amount in the
cafeteria
yesterday, when...

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's so lucky. She can eat all that and
still maintain her racing weight. I guess
she must have good
metabolism or
something...

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No matter how much I run or how little I eat, I still struggle to hit my target. I wish I could eat without a care too... Sigh... Life can be so cruel.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It surprised me. I didn't realize that
people can't
always eat what they want,
or as much as they
want...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Or even that people could be sad when
they see
me eat a lot.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But one lunch box... isn't enough.
choice_data_list: So that's why you came somewhere s...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to eat more...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to eat more...
choice_data_list: It's better to just eat without wo...
I'm sure there's a good reason you...
I think there's a reason you eat s...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of students besides
Oguri Cap who eat a lot. Even if she
started eating less, I doubt things would
get any easier for that other 
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: It's better to just eat without wo...
I'm sure there's a good reason you...
I think there's a reason you eat s...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you're right. But still... It makes
me sad.
choice_data_list: Maybe it's something you just have...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Eating should make everyone happy, but
it's only
bringing her suffering... and
that's tragic...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know Oguri Cap's heart is in the right
place, but she's not helping anyone by
starving herself. And
since she can't
change reality, she might as well...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...
choice_data_list: Then let's enjoy plenty of good fo...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I will.
choice_data_list: I know everything will turn out fine.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Oguri's eating even more than
usual today.
And still...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She looks so happy... It's actually kinda
making
me wanna eat more too!

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Urk... It all looks sooo good. Fried rice,
ramen, fried chicken...
I mean... oil,
carbs, oily carbs... I can't touch any of
that!

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh... That's it! I can't hold out
forever! Carbs
and oily foods are just too
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
That's the girl from yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should try talking to a dietitian
or
something...
Yeah! We can figure it
out together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now, where was I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap does eat a huge—no, an astonishing amount of food. But she's astonishingly active as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's true for other Umamusume as
well, but... given the sheer quantity of
food Oguri Cap consumes, her exercise
regimen must be on another level
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see... So that's it...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Basically...
I just have to show her that I
eat a lot
and I exercise a whole lot too.
choice_data_list: Hm? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So all we have to do is train together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
After this break, we're doing crunches.
Ten sets of
a hundred.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That afternoon, I spot Oguri Cap
exercising
alongside a younger student.

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Th-this is... ridiculous...

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, Oguri... Do you always train this
hard?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No... I reduced the number of sets since
we're
training together today. Usually, I
do about...
twice as many?

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Geez... No wonder you eat so much.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
How about you? Are you going to eat a
whole lot
today?

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The food you have after this training
session will
taste incredible. I guarantee
it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
First you train hard, then you eat your
favorite
foods. It's fine to have days like
that sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So if I can just keep up with this
level of
training... I can
stop worrying about
calories, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dieting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, Oguri! Add some more weight,
please. I want
to eat a bowl of ramen
heaping with roast pork
after this!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Right!
